channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: One US dollar now costs 2 million rials in Iran, and here’s what it can buy
item.description: Sanctions and the US-Israel war on Iran have left the country's people unable to keep pace with rising prices.

item.title: At least eight killed as Nepal flash flood damages roads, energy facilities
item.description: Authorities say casualties could be much higher, alongside heavier losses of property.

item.title: The Bulgarian village that fears becoming an Iranian target
item.description: US Air Force refuelling planes caused anxiety in Bezmer. While their departure has brought relief, tensions persist.

item.title: Trump threatens Iran’s partners: How do secondary sanctions work?
item.description: The US has used threats of secondary sanctions, whereby countries trading with a sanctioned country also face sanctions.

item.title: Iran, Oman agree on new temporary route in Hormuz
item.description: Deputy foreign minster says the route's entry as well as part of the exit would run through Iranian territorial waters.

item.title: Iran bets economic pain will pressure Trump in game of ‘chicken’
item.description: Iran is betting global economic fallout and Republicans worried about the midterms will force Trump's retreat.

item.title: At least 17 killed as flash flood sweeps part of Nepal-Tibet border
item.description: The flood in Rasuwa - an area north of Kathmandu bordering Tibet - is feared to have swept away villages.

item.title: Far-right Israeli lawmaker damages Palestinian memorial with sledgehammer
item.description: Zvi Sukkot's actions have drawn widespread condemnation, including from Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu.

item.title: Trump says all mines cleared from Strait of Hormuz
item.description: Iran has closed the vital waterway since the beginning of the conflict causing wild fluctuations in oil prices worldwide.

item.title: China hits out at 'illegal' new US sanctions on Iran and trading partners
item.description: The US has threatened to isolate nations that continue to do business with Tehran, which sells much of its oil to Beijing.
